title: Big slicer update
body: Multicolor prints now slice with their real colors. Pick a plate on multi-plate   files. New Print Preprocessing popup before sending: choose printer, remap tool heads, see per-color filament use.   Open .3mf/.stl files straight from your browser or file manager. New Supports, Infill, Ironing and Brim options on   the prepare screen. Plus: fixed the tab bar hiding behind Android's navigation buttons.
